newsitem.title: CANADA: Western Star will defend US$60 mln lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Western Star will defend US$60 mln lawsuit.

text.p: Western Star Trucks Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday a lawsuit was filed by Parts Enroute Inc against Western Star and its subsidiaries, Orion Bus Industries Ltd and Orion Bus Industries Inc.
Western Star said it intended to defend vigorously against the lawsuit, which seeks injunctive relief and treble damages totalling US$60 million.
The lawsuit, filed by Parts Enroute in U.S. Federal court, alleged that Orion attempted to coerce vendors of bus parts to stop doing business with them, Western Star said.
It said the claims were not material to the company.
Parts Enroute alleged that the violations occurred for less than two years, Western Star said.

According to the complaint, Parts Enroute's projected sales for this year at C$6 million, Western Star said. It said Parts Enroute did not state the dollar amount of sales that occurred in the United States and which are subject to their claims under U.S. antitrust laws.
